bandos.name: Chiari e Forti
bandos.about: The old Chiari e Forti oil factory on the Sile river: brick and yellow blocks, a ruined factory, the water tower and the "cuore" lantern tower.

bandos.name: Bando Villetta
bandos.about: An abandoned shed of four barrel-vault halls with its annex, an old greenhouse frame and concrete aprons, in the fields near Treviso.
